items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I was fortunate in getting Ed Hall

ctx.x: The one downtown? I think I even did something with you in the downtown one, I can't remember where it was, maybe it was a day or something.

Yeah. Well, Benny Morton was the one musician straight through the whole period -- never changed trombones, and let's see, on clarinet, Jimmy Hamilton went with me, too, and then I was fortunate in getting Ed Hall, one of the greatest jazz clarinet players that ever lived.
